# FREESNAP

> FREESNAP is an iPhone app that turns a screen recording of scrolling content into one continuous long screenshot. It processes the recording, stitches overlapping frames, supports cropping, and exports the result on-device.

English is the primary product reference. Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese pages provide localized versions of the same product facts.

## Product facts

- Platform: iPhone and iOS.
- Main input: a live ReplayKit screen recording or an existing portrait screen recording imported from Photos.
- Main output: one continuous long image that the user can crop, save, or share.
- Typical content: chats, webpages, long articles, product pages, orders, and reviews.
- User interaction: the user scrolls manually; FREESNAP does not auto-scroll another app.
- Privacy: recording analysis, stitching, and cropping happen on-device. FREESNAP does not upload screen content, require an account, use ads, or use third-party analytics.
- Availability: the app is free to download and includes an optional non-consumable PRO purchase.

## Important distinction

The iPhone Full Page screenshot option is available only for supported content and apps. FREESNAP works from a screen recording, so it can create long screenshots from more scrollable views. It does not bypass copy protection, access private app data, or scroll pages automatically.
